description: Comment on exact passages of an agent's reply and send every comment with your next message. Select text, choose Add to chat, and type or dictate a note in a card next to the passage. Each passage stays highlighted and appears as a pill in the composer, where a click edits or deletes its comment. The agent receives each quoted passage next to its comment. Comments stay on your bb server; no external service or account is needed. Requires bb 0.46 or later.
